senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בר, v. ברר, ברי)to cave out. Denom. בְּרֵכָה, בֶּרֶךְ; cmp. בּוּרְכָּא, בּוּרְכְּתָא.

units: Gen. II, 3) whence to bless (Pi.).—Part. pass. בָּרוּךְ chosen, blessed, praised. הקדוש ב׳ הוא (abbr. הקב״ה) the Holy One, blessed be He.
Ib. 104ᵇ, a. fr. פותח בב׳ וכ׳ he (who prays) opens the benediction with barukh and closes with barukh (i.e. ברוך אתה ה׳).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 1:10">Tosef. Sot. I, 10</cite> <he>ב׳ בכלל</he>, v. <cite ref="K00760"><he>כְּלָל</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to praise, bless, esp. to recite the due benediction.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>בי׳ על היין</he> having recited the blessing over wine &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:9">Pes. X, 9</cite> <he>ב׳ ברכת הפסח</he> having recited the blessing over the Paschal lamb.
<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 10:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>אנחנו חייבים … לְבָרֵךְ</he> we are bound to … praise &c.; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 56a:4">Snh. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שֶיְבָרֵךְ שם בשם</he> until he blasphemes the Lord by His name.
Ib. שבי׳ את השם בכינוי who blasphemed the Lord by an attribute.—Part. Pu. מְבוֹרָךְ blessed, praiseworthy.

senses.gloss: *to cut through, to clear virgin ground or forest.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 3:20">Tosef. Shebi. III, 20</cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>מגדר</he>); Y. ib. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>מבדין</he>; Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᵃ top <he>המברה</he>, v. <cite ref="B00170"><he>בהי</he></cite> h. [<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:6">Tosef. Shebi. I, 6</cite> <he>מבורכות</he>, v. infra.]

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְבָּרֵךְ to be blessed (praised); to be increased (v. בְּרָכָה). Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ top ויִתְבָּרַךְ and be blessed. Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80ᵃ if the waters were scanty ונִתְבָּרְכוּ and grew plentiful.
(denom. of בֶּרֶךְ or בְּרִיכָה) to form a knee, to engraft; esp. to bend a vine by drawing it into the ground and making it grow forth as an independent plant, to sink.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:6">Shebi. II, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 10b">R. Hash. 10ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 1:6">Tosef. Shebi. I, 6</cite> <he>אם היו מוּבְרָכוֹת</he> (incorr. <he>מבורכ׳</he>) if they have been sunk before New Year &c.—

<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:6">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> (allud. to <cite ref="Genesis 12:3">Gen. XII, 3</cite>) <he>שתי ברכית טובות יש לי להַבְרִיךְ בך</he> two good shoots (proselytes) have I to engraft on thee, Ruth and &c. (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38b">B. Kam. 38ᵇ</cite> … <he>פרידות וכ׳</he>).
